findings.title: traceID field silently dropped from the "Plugin Request Completed" log line
findings.body: Before this PR, logRequest explicitly extracted the trace ID with tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) and appended it as a "traceID" log field. That code is removed, and the log line now relies entirely on m.logger.FromContext(ctx), which only picks up the contextual attributes injected by the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext: endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname. No trace ID is added there, and neither log.WithContextualAttributes nor the infra logger's FromContext injects a trace ID automatically (the metrics middleware still calls tracing.TraceIDFromContext explicitly for exemplars, confirming it isn't automatic). The result is that the grafana-data-egress "Plugin Request Completed" log loses its traceID field, breaking log-to-trace correlation that previously existed — a behavior change not mentioned in the PR description, which presents this as a pure rename/move. If the removal isn't intentional, re-add traceID either in logRequest via tracing.TraceIDFromContext or in ContextualLoggerMiddleware's attribute list.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance, so logs via FromContext are unobservable in tests
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() rather than the receiver f. Since LoggerMiddleware now logs exclusively through m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), any test that builds the middleware with log.NewTestLogger() and then asserts on logger.InfoLogs.Calls/Message will observe zero calls — the log entry is recorded on a throwaway instance the test cannot access, producing silently misleading results. Because TestLogger is the provided fake for the plugins log.Logger interface, FromContext should return f so that logs emitted through a derived logger are captured in the same Logs structs.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware and its interaction with LoggerMiddleware have no test coverage
findings.body: The PR adds ContextualLoggerMiddleware with no test file. instrumentContext has conditional branches (DataSourceInstanceSettings nil, User nil) that are unexercised, and more importantly the central behavior change of this PR — LoggerMiddleware emitting endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname by reading context attributes set by ContextualLoggerMiddleware — is untested: metrics_middleware_test.go only asserts prometheus metrics, and nothing wires the two middlewares together to verify the resulting log fields. A wiring regression (for example, swapping the middleware order in CreateMiddlewares so the logger no longer sees the attributes, or dropping one of the attribute keys) would not be caught by any test.
